active_track_mixed: Exactly 1 provider passes, or strong-gate components disagree materially across providers.
active_track_negative: No provider passes AND at least 2 providers show reversal on both aggregate lesion families.
active_track_positive: At least 2 of the 3 preregistered providers pass the provider strong gate.
important_design_note: This is a prospective cross-provider replication, not a literal repetition of the original three-rep WF1-A Luna experiment. Provider replication replaces within-cell repetition as the principal new replication axis.
interpretation_boundary: Black-box behavioral structural evidence only. Model-native module is an indirect output-based proxy, not direct inspection of weights, activations, hidden circuits, training data, or global uniqueness.

provider_strong_gate.pure8_reverse: mean excess distance > 0 and one-sided sign-flip p < 0.01
provider_strong_gate.pure9_delete: mean excess distance > 0 and one-sided sign-flip p < 0.01
provider_strong_gate.specificity: R, X and Y each excess distance > 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.01

scientific_role: Prospective cross-provider replication of the strongest frozen WF1-A causal/relational-topology authority. This is separate from, and cannot rescue, the passive V13/V14/V17 track.
